title.en: Integrating the Balaoan School of Fisheries Located At Barangay Paraoir, Balaoan La Union With the Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State College and Appropriating Funds for the Purpose

text.en:
The Balaoan School of Fisheries at Paraoir, Balaoan, La Union, is hereby integrated with the
Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State College at Bacnotan, La Union.

The Balaoan School of Fisheries shall become the nucleus of an educational program to provide
professional and advance vocational and technical instructions in fisheries, geared towards the development of
the aqua-marine resources particularly of the province of La Union, and of the Ilocos Region.

The general supervision over all assets, fixed and movable, records, and other properties of the
Balaoan School of Fisheries shall be transferred to the Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State College.

The incumbent officials, instructional staff and other personnel of the Balaoan School of
Fisheries shall continue to serve in their respective functions under their present authorized salary rates, until
such time when funds shall be available for the adjustment of salaries in accordance with approved salary
scales for state colleges and universities.

The Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State College is hereby authorized to acquire lands of the
public domain and to exercise the right of eminent domain for the sites of an expanded fishery education

In addition to the current appropriations of the Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State College and
the Balaoan School of Fisheries, the sum of one million pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the

National Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the expansion of the fishery education program. Thereafter,
funds for this purpose shall be included in the annual budget of the Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State

The Minister of Education and Culture is hereby directed to take such steps as are necessary for
the immediate implementation of this Decree.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 12th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
